# Spelling Bee

> A spelling practice app that uses spaced repetition to help learners master 117,000+ words.

Spelling Bee is a free Progressive Web App for spelling practice and vocabulary building. It targets learners ages 6-18 and uses scientifically-backed spaced repetition (Leitner box system) with adaptive difficulty to optimize learning.

## Key Facts

- 117,000+ words across 10 difficulty levels
- Free to use, works offline as a PWA
- Spaced repetition with 5-box Leitner system
- Adaptive difficulty adjusts in real-time based on answer speed
- Daily challenges with global leaderboard
- Competition/bee simulation mode for spelling bee preparation
- Every example sentence is a real published citation, not AI-generated
- Three-layer child safety filtering on all content
- Cloud sync across devices via Firebase
